meta.title: ASN Creation by Vendor (Portal/EDI): refused for a user without the Vendor role
gaps: Open or invoke ASN Creation by Vendor (Portal/EDI) and observe whether a non-Vendor user is refused or the action is absent.
Repeat ASN creation as a Vendor and verify that the action is available.
Sign in as two distinct users with different roles in the same tenant.
Verify or provision that the tenant is on the Enterprise plan.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open or invoke ASN Creation by Vendor (Portal/EDI) and observe whether a non-Vendor user is refused or the action is absent.; Repeat ASN creation as a Vendor and verify that the action is available.; Sign in as two distinct users with different roles in the same tenant.; Verify or provision that the tenant is on the Enterprise plan.

args.need: sign in as the non-Vendor user and attempt ASN Creation by Vendor (Portal/EDI), then repeat in the same tenant as a Vendor and record whether the action is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: Role-specific identities, tenant plan context, and the ASN workflow are not available in the catalog.
Record that the resulting screen has no visible application crash or server error after the tester's role comparison.
